title: Question 1.0: Understanding the Dataset
instruction: This dataset contains restaurant reviews with their sentiment labels. Understanding the data structure is the first step in building a machine learning model.
reveal: This dataset has 2 columns (features): "text" (the review) and "sentiment" (the label: positive or negative). In machine learning, "features" are the input variables that the model uses to make predictions. Here, the "text" column is our feature - it's what we'll use to predict the "sentiment". The "sentiment" column is the label (the answer we're trying to predict). The dataset contains thousands of restaurant reviews, each labeled as either positive or negative.
